TITLE: Basic
DESC: Basic effect that activates when using a skill.

TITLE: Assist
DESC: Supportive effect that activates when using a skill.

TITLE: Remove Disabled
DESC: This effect is unaffected by removal.

TITLE: Immunity Disabled
DESC: Effect is applied even if the target has Immunity skill.

TITLE: Bleeding DMG
DESC:
Deals Bleeding Damage for a certain period of time.
When the target is bleeding,
the amount of health recovered is halved.
This can be removed with the Remove Harmful Effects.

TITLE: Bleeding (Repeated)
DESC: Deals repeated Bleeding Damage every second\nto the frontline enemy during the battle.

TITLE: Bleeding (All)
DESC: Deals Bleeding Damage every second to\nall members of the target team.

TITLE: Blitz Team Bonus
DESC: Increases the basic stat of all dispatched\nmembers of the team by 10%\nduring a Guild Blitz battle.

TITLE: Remove CRIT DMG Immunity
DESC: Removes the opponent's Critical Damage Immunity effect.

TITLE: Strengthen
DESC: Temporarily increases stat.\nThis can be removed with the Remove Beneficial Effects.

TITLE: Strengthen (Cont.)
DESC: Increases stat until the battle ends.\nThis can be stacked several times.\nThis can be removed with the Remove Beneficial Effects.

TITLE: Strengthened DEF (Repeated)
DESC: During battle, Defense increases 2x every 3 seconds.\nThis won't be activated when Beneficial Effect is blocked.

TITLE: Remove Beneficial Effects
DESC: Removes all Beneficial Effects of the target.

TITLE: Remove Harmful Effects
DESC: Removes all Harmful Effects of the target.\nNot activated while affected by Beneficial Effect Block.

TITLE: Remove Harmful Effects (Repeated)
DESC: Removes their Harmful Effects every second.\nNot activated while affected by Beneficial Effect Block.

TITLE: Counterattack▲
DESC: The number of counterattacks against\nthe enemy's attack increases.

TITLE: Fixed DMG 2000
DESC: Deals 2000 damage regardless of the target's defense.\nThe amount of damage increase or decrease due to element will be reflected.

TITLE: Weaken
DESC: Temporarily decreases stat.\nThis can be removed with the Remove Harmful Effects.

TITLE: Weaken (Cont.)
DESC: Decreases stat until the battle ends.\nThis can be stacked several times.\nThis can be removed with the Remove Harmful Effects.

TITLE: Weaken (Stacked)
DESC: Continuously weakens the target when the battle starts.\nThis can be removed with the Remove Harmful Effects.

TITLE: Weaken (Self)
DESC: Weakens self.\nThis can be removed with the Remove Harmful Effects.

TITLE: Deep Wound
DESC: Deals Bleeding Damage that is maintained until deactivation.\nRemoves the basic Regeneration while standing by.\nThis can be removed with the Remove Harmful Effects.

TITLE: Switch Block
DESC: Target is unable to switch out for a certain period of time.\nThe target will switch out when targeted by Force Switch effect or upon becoming unable to battle.

TITLE: Attack Disabled
DESC: The target cannot attack for a certain period of time.\nThis can be removed with the Remove Harmful Effects.

TITLE: Cont. Recovery
DESC: Continuously recovers HP every second\nfor a certain period of time.\nThis can be removed with the Remove Beneficial Effects.

TITLE: Cont. Recovery (Team)
DESC: Continuously recovers the HP of all members of\nthe team every second for a certain period of time.\nThis can be removed with the Remove Beneficial Effects.

TITLE: Stat Decrease
DESC: Decreases the target's stat who is\nfighting against the hunter.

TITLE: Fight Club Bonus
DESC: Increases the basic stat of self by 10%\nduring a Fight Club battle.

TITLE: Force Switch
DESC: Switches out the target and retreats them.

TITLE: Rage Decrease
DESC: Able to decrease Rage Gauge.

TITLE: Rage Increase
DESC: Able to increase Rage Gauge.

TITLE: Halve Defense
DESC: Decreases 50% of the target's defense instantly.\nThe skill's amount of damage is calculated afterwards.

TITLE: Strike
DESC: Deals great damage to the target in an instant.

TITLE: Strike All
DESC: Deals great damage to all members of the target team instantly.

TITLE: Recovery
DESC: Recovers the target's HP instantly.

TITLE: Team Recovery
DESC: Recovers the HP of all members of the team instantly.

TITLE: Ignore Defense
DESC: Although the target's defense increases,\nthe amount of damage doesn't decrease.\nNot activated while affected by Beneficial Effect Block.

TITLE: Ignore DMG▼
DESC: The amount of damage of this skill\nignores the target's Damage Reduction.

TITLE: Ignore Immunity
DESC: The target engaging in battle with this hunter\ncannot benefit from Immunity.

TITLE: Beneficial Effect Block
DESC: Blocks the target from getting Beneficial Effects\nduring a certain period of time.

TITLE: CRIT DMG Immunity
DESC: When attacked by an opponent,\nCritical Damage is not applied.

TITLE: Harmful Effect Immunity
DESC: Immune to Harmful Effects for a certain period of time.\nThis can be removed with the Remove Beneficial Effects.

TITLE: Harmful Immunity (ATK)
DESC: Gains Immunity from attack weakening effects\namong the Harmful Effects.

TITLE: Harmful Immunity (DEF)
DESC: Gains Immunity from defense weakening effects\namong the Harmful Effects.

TITLE: Harmful Immunity (DMG▼)
DESC: Gains Immunity from Damage Reduction weakening effects\namong the Harmful Effects.

TITLE: ATK Disabled Immunity
DESC: Gains Immunity to Attack Disabled effects.

TITLE: Stun Immunity
DESC: Doesn't get stunned by skill.

TITLE: Stun Immunity (Support)
DESC: Protects the team from getting stunned by a Bomber or Support.\nIt cannot block stun from Offense or Defense.

TITLE: Immunity
DESC: Becomes Immune to damage for a certain period of time.\nThis can be removed with the Remove Beneficial Effects.\nTakes damage from attacks with Immunity Penetration.

TITLE: Immunity Block
DESC: Cannot become Immune for a certain period of time.\nThis can be removed with the Remove Harmful Effects.

TITLE: Immunity Penetration
DESC: Able to deal damage to the target with Immunity.

TITLE: Immunity (Repeated)
DESC: Becomes Immune once every 3 seconds.

TITLE: Team Immunity
DESC: All members of the team become Immune during a\ncertain period of time. This can be removed\nwith the Remove Beneficial Effects.

TITLE: Role
DESC: The common effect that is granted\naccording to the hunter's role.

TITLE: Offense
DESC: Offense's role ability.\nOffense's attack increases when the battle starts.

TITLE: Defense
DESC: Defense's role ability.\nDefense's defense increases when the battle starts.

TITLE: Bomber
DESC: Bomber's role ability.\nThe whole team's attack increases when the battle starts.

TITLE: Support
DESC: Support's role ability.\nThe whole team's HP increases when the battle starts.

TITLE: Maximization
DESC: Additional effect that is activated randomly\nwhen using a skill.

TITLE: Special
DESC: Hunter's special personal ability.\nThe effect is activated continuously when the battle starts.

TITLE: Natural Recovery
DESC: The target's HP recovers continuously\nwhen the battle starts.

TITLE: Stat Increase
DESC: Increases the target's stat when the battle starts.

TITLE: Stun
DESC: Stuns the target,\ntemporarily preventing them from taking any action.

TITLE: Special Stun
DESC: Stuns the target under special conditions.

TITLE: Concussion
DESC: Stuns the target for a longer duration.\nStuns the target for half the duration if the target has stun immunity.

TITLE: Stun (Teammate)
DESC: Stuns a teammate.\nA special side effect that only some hunters have.

TITLE: Stun (Self)
DESC: Stuns self.\nA special side effect that only some hunters have.

TITLE: Stun All
DESC: Stuns all members of the target team for a certain period of time.

TITLE: Team Stat▲
DESC: Increases the stat of all members of target team\nwhen the battle starts.

TITLE: Team Stat▼
DESC: Decreases the stat of all members of target team\nwhen the battle starts.

TITLE: Reverse
DESC: Deals damage to the opponent\nby using the opponent's attack.
